questions.question: List all the possible outcomes when you roll an ordinary die and when you toss a coin.
questions.expected_answer: A die has 6 possible outcomes: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6. A coin has 2 possible outcomes: heads and tails.

questions.question: Lindiwe tossed a coin 20 times and got heads 11 times. How many tails did she get, and is the coin unfair?
questions.expected_answer: 20 minus 11 is 9, so she got 9 tails. The coin is not shown to be unfair, because small differences like 11 and 9 are normal in 20 trials.

questions.question: A spinner is half red, a quarter blue and a quarter green. Which colour should come up most often? Explain.
questions.expected_answer: Red should come up most often, because the red part is the biggest. It is half of the spinner, twice as big as each of the other parts.
